title: Concept · System colours · Sparks
description: GPU, heat, memory and interconnect health for the Spark machines, so a slow or failing model can be traced to its cause. Shared CPU/GPU memory usage is host memory usage, not GPU allocation.

panels.description: Memory left. Orange is under 4 GiB and red is under the 2 GiB stop line.
The hotter of the board and the GPU. The board's critical trip point is 104.8 °C; orange is the 95 °C it reaches under heavy load and red is the 99.8 °C alert.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (label_set(max by (instance) (max_over_time(node_thermal_zone_temp{job="spark-node",platform="spark",instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])), "source", "board") or label_set(max by (instance) (max_over_time(nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu{job="spark-gpu",platform="spark",instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])), "source", "gpu"))

panels.description: The fullest persistent filesystem on each Spark. The low-space alert fires at 90%.
Seconds the GPUs spent in hardware thermal slowdown in the last hour.
RoCE errors on the ports linking the two Sparks in the last hour.

panels.title: GPU temperature
panels.description: Highest temperature in each step. Red bands are when the GPU slowed itself for heat.

panels.title: GPU power
panels.description: Highest draw in each step, for the GPU alone. The CPU, network card and drive are not included. Amber bands are the power cap, which is ordinary operation.

panels.title: GPU clock
panels.description: Average shader clock against the device's maximum. Grey bands are when the GPU is busy, the only time a clock means anything. A busy clock far below its usual level with no slowdown is worth a look.

panels.title: Memory available
panels.description: Memory left. CPU and GPU share one pool, so a loaded model keeps this low by design. The orange line is the 8 GiB goal and the red line the 2 GiB stop line. Red bands are memory stalls above 10%.

panels.title: Board temperature
panels.description: Hottest ACPI thermal zone in each step. It usually runs hotter than the GPU. The red line is the firmware's critical trip point, 104.8 °C.

panels.title: Drives and network
panels.description: NVMe composite temperature, with the ConnectX adapters dashed. Tensor-parallel work adds RDMA load to a card that already runs warm.

panels.title: RoCE traffic
panels.description: Data sent over the adapter ports that link the two Sparks. The second port pair carries none. Red bands are link-downs, timeouts, sequence errors, receive errors or retransmits.
